change.summary: Add independent terrain shadows, configurable chunk lighting coverage and sunlight scattering in Sandbox.

modifiers.after: configurable 8, 12, 15 or 20 blocks at full emission
2 to 32 loaded chunks, optionally follows the effective render distance

modifiers.before: full blocks and selected native shapes
modifiers.after: baked rectangular model geometry or native outlines, with foliage transmission

modifiers.before: native vertical sheets with additional native falling particles
modifiers.after: three variants per mode with individual swirls, diagonal rain and ordinary snow, predominantly horizontal blizzards and sand, two flakes per accepted blizzard spawn, and native weather state and ground impacts
animated calm curls, fast ground waves and diagonal storm gusts with configurable biome colors

modifiers.before: native light replacement depended on traced visibility
modifiers.after: geometry-traced light replacement follows volume coverage and directional light follows visibility

modifiers.before: diffuse angle loss within a moving terrain volume and approximate entity ellipsoids
modifiers.after: sun and moon use terrain occlusion and nearby animated entity geometry, with entity map resolution selectable from 256 through 2048
supported nearby living entity model faces occlude each modeled terrain light independently
sun and moon shafts bounded by scene depth with per-sample light contrast perpendicular to the celestial direction
independent global rain and storm sliders, 25 to 200 percent, default 100 and 150 percent respectively

modifiers.before: built-in surface and underground biome fog
native lifetime with outdoor wind drift
modifiers.after: longer gradual fade, nominal 10-block rise for ordinary smoke, plus 1.5 blocks per nearby lit campfire to a shared 20-block ceiling, with darker and denser smoke in clusters. Above 5 blocks, the sprite grows 5 percent per 2 blocks and an exposed plume bends up to 4 extra blocks downwind

rationale.purpose: Extend the approved lighting preview to playable terrain while retaining native block emission and sky light inputs.
rationale.decision_source: User requested ordinary Embeddium chunks, emissive blocks and simultaneous sunlight in Sandbox only, on Windows and macOS. The local voxel volume, solid pass and eight-source budget are implementation choices.

introduced.summary: Apply original terrain lighting during opaque Embeddium chunk draws.

history.summary: Extend the scene to native block emission and opaque terrain.
Address reported lighting bands and seams with scale-independent normals, interval ray intersections, native door and snow shapes, and modeled flame origins. Apply lighting to cutout receivers.
Add depth-aware daylight scattering and haze, adjustable volume update speed and lighting range, and exposed-face light origins for solid emitters.
Index loaded emitters by receiving section, trace supported baked block models or native outlines, and attenuate rays through leaves.
Preserve distant source contributions through the local trace transition. Add weather visuals, celestial scattering, water optics and approximate shadow casters.
Replace the native falling precipitation visuals with diagonal rain and snow and horizontal blizzards and sand. Keep native weather authority, custom dimension handlers and impacts.
Add biome-tinted wind gusts and double blizzard flake density. Stop occluders from restoring the same point source's native light contribution.
Use a typed smoke movement redirect, fix directional blocker loss, project entity model geometry and expose global precipitation density controls.
Add cluster-responsive smoke, scene-depth biome fog and particle variation with three-dimensional weather motion.
Replace fog and shaft composition and add moonlight, local model-shaped entity shadows and directional map resolution.
Remove the custom air fog and add height-based smoke drift and sprite scale.
Use one stronger terrain-occluded path for sun and moon shafts and remove point-light haze.
Use contrast across the light direction at each sample to concentrate celestial scattering near blocker edges.

notes: No gameplay registrations, server state or native block emission levels change. The standalone preview remains available.
unresolved: Visual output and frame time require verification on Windows and macOS. Local entity occlusion uses captured model faces without texel alpha testing. Dedicated Better Clouds projection, Voxy LOD shadow receivers and shader-pack coexistence are outside this pass.
